title: [29x]-Export Electronic Payments: one vendor's missing email can clear another vendor's Document No.
summary: Fixed a bug in bulk vendor remittance reporting where a missing email address for one vendor would incorrectly clear the document number field for other vendors during electronic payment export.
key_points: Bug in Bulk Vendor Remit Reporting codeunit where vendor email validation affected unrelated vendors
Missing email for one vendor would cause another vendor's document number to be cleared
Electronic payment export process now handles missing emails without cross-vendor data corruption
Test coverage added for the electronic funds transfer scenario
quote: one vendor's missing email can clear another vendor's Document No
